decision.acceptance_fixture_unchanged: A1 -> B1 forward and A1 -> C2 broadcast remains the mandatory first branched metadata fixture.
decision.generic_profile: partitioned-dag-v1 accepts a connected acyclic graph with exactly one SOURCE, at least two operators, at least one edge, and exactly one logical input on every non-source operator.
decision.linear_parallel_control: Add a metadata control for a valid linear parallel DAG such as A2 -> B3 rebalance or A2 -> B2 -> C2.
unsupported: more than one logical input per operator

reason: Mandatory fan-out and a three-operator minimum describe the first acceptance fixture, not the approved generic acyclic DAG profile. Keeping them as profile constraints would reject valid fixed-parallelism chains and force a later profile fork.
replaces_in_handoff: bounds.first_gate shape remains four TaskRuns/two workers but is not a minimum profile shape
contract.topology minimum changes from three operators/two edges/mandatory fan-out to two operators/one edge/fan-out optional
acceptance no longer refuses linear-only topology or fewer than three operators; it still refuses source-only topology
retained: one SOURCE root and complete reachability
one output and at most one input port per operator
no DAG execution, routing or DATA
